why: the zero-initialiser of `rclc_polling_action_server_t`, in rcl's `rcl_action_get_zero_initialized_*` role. RFC-0022's polling tier for actions, as its own type since phase-487 W4 (RFC-0096 D9, the C half). Nothing dispatches it, so it has no arena slot and keeps its core inline. The C++ twin is `nros::PollingActionServer<A>`.
